recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future changes to the external IG list should be made in the IG registry/package registry infrastructure rather than by restoring a core-spec homepage link to the retired wiki or Confluence list.
issue_request: FHIR-5880 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core change request asking that the wiki page for profiles developed by organizations outside HL7 be discoverable from the FHIR specification homepage.
initial_application: The request was applied by git-svn commit 5e96122d85e43d56da1bed66eb82f4e71411f03, which changed source/index.html to add an Implementation guide registry link to the old wiki page, matching the Jira comment that cites SVN revision 5053.
additional_context: Later source history replaced the wiki link with the Confluence successor and then with maintained registry links. The current homepage points to the curated IG list, registry.fhir.org artifacts, and the packages2.fhir.org XIG index; source/profilelist.html also directs additional profiles and extensions to registry.fhir.org. The Confluence successor page now points to the Implementation Guide Registry, and Zulip discussion records that IHE guides had moved into fhir.org/guides/registry and that the old wiki/spec-homepage link could be removed or replaced. FHIR-16526 later reinforced the registry-based cleanup for homepage/navigation and IG discovery.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing the retired wiki or Confluence page link would add obsolete indirection, while the current homepage already provides maintained discovery paths for external IG/profile artifacts.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive with Modification homepage issue that moved IGs from the Confluence page into the HL7 IG registry and updated homepage/navigation registry links.
